Definition: a Shunite (collectively) or descendants of Shuni
BiblicalUsage: Shuni is a Shunite, a descendant of Shuni of Gad, named once in the census of the families. The children of Gad are counted by their fathers' houses, and the family of the Shunites stands in its place.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the families of Gad are counted one by one, and God does not skip a family when He numbers His people.
